name: @ufoq/opencode-agent-terminal
description: OpenCode plugin that bundles the agent-terminal CLI and skill
author: ufoq

scripts.build: rm -rf dist skills bin && cp -R ../../skills skills && export PATH="/home/agent/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && mkdir -p bin/linux-x64 && cp ../../../target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/agent-terminal bin/linux-x64/agent-terminal && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
